w: Then there's the building. The proposed plan includes about twenty-one billion dollars of capital over four years, about four point four billion of it in twenty twenty-seven. That is about one point eight times the City's forecast capital spending for twenty twenty-five. More than forty per cent of the new capital is for water, wastewater and stormwater. Large projects are built by contractors, in a tight construction labour market. And capital that isn't spent is moved to later years. So the question is not only what Calgarians would pay, but what pace the plan would require.
